rca of the issue: CI executed on Monday UTC exposed two day-of-week-sensitive tests that assumed a mid-week clock. iter157 seeded a closed trade at 'now - 3 days' which on Mon/Tue/Wed rolls into the prior ISO week, so the weekly-composition fingerprint stayed identical and risk_state_source stayed 'maintained' instead of the expected 'recomputed'. iter221 r5 seeded trades at Monday 01:00 UTC to simulate weekly loss accumulation, but on Monday runs those trades are ALSO today's trades, so the daily cap (evaluated before the weekly cap in modules/pamm) fires with reason 'daily_loss_cap_reached' before the weekly cap is reached. Fix (test-only): (a) iter157 uses days_back=min(3, now.weekday()) to keep the seed inside the current week and gates the move-to-today recompute assertion on days_back>0 (no-op on Monday); (b) iter221 r5 branches its reason assertion on now.weekday()==0 (daily) vs otherwise (weekly + weekly_loss_pct>=5.0); (c) iter221 r10 asserts snapshot.reason == live.reason so the persistence contract is verified regardless of which cap trips.
